jump_control.algorithm: upstream jump_mpc phase logic adapted to Isaac
jump_control.landing_transition: source landing MPC absorbs the bilateral impact; after vertical velocity settles, double-support WBC keeps both feet fixed and raises the body, then the recovery WBC continues the steady double-support hold in the complete phase

controller_build_provenance.scope: Compile manifests and generated C++ source hashes agree except for OPENLOONG_MPC_N; run.json pins the loaded library hash. Historical build-time snapshots are not reconstructed.

sampling_boundary: QP status counts are states.csv samples (100 Hz), not unique QP solve counts. Nonzero status counts are disclosed and do not change the recording-integrity verdict; inspect stage metrics for behavioral acceptance.
